Question B-004-001-004.

Why the correct answer is right: A microphone produces an audio-frequency signal, so the correct stage for increasing it is an audio amplifier.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "an RF oscillator": An RF oscillator creates a radio-frequency signal instead of raising microphone audio.
- sourceIndex 2: "an RF amplifier": An RF amplifier works at radio frequencies, not directly on the microphone audio signal.
- sourceIndex 3: "an audio oscillator": An audio oscillator creates a tone; it is not the stage used to raise an existing microphone signal.
